entry.summary:
Watch the livestreamed panel talk facilitated by Tamahou Temara with waka knowledge holders Joe Conrad, Stan Conrad, and Robert Gabel, Te Rawhitiroa Bosch, Billy Harrison, and Martin Bercic and learn how they paved the way for waka revival. 

The panel talk marked the closing of the exhibition He Kaupapa Waka at Te Papa in May 2026 and reflected on where the waka revival movement is now, what the future holds, and the creation of the exhibition.

https://www.tepapa.govt.nz/
